stops.note: the capital of Menorca, said to be the birthplace of the creamy egg-and-oil sauce
adapted in French for the rich, creamy sauce named after the city
settled as the English word for the creamy condiment
stops.meaning: a creamy condiment made from egg yolk and oil

current_meaning: a creamy condiment made by emulsifying egg yolk, oil, and vinegar or lemon juice
